title: Long-code assignment
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let a table assign to each vertex a Boolean function on $\\{ -1,1 \\}^q$ with values in the sign set $\\{ -1,1 \\}$. The long-code assignment maps each pair consisting of a vertex and an input in $\\{ -1,1 \\}^q$ to the value of that vertex's function at the input.
